data.source: Kraken public Trades API (SOLUSD), aggregated to 5m candles; completed candles only

method.sizing: 1% risk of balance, capped to the balance (no leverage), long-only, compounding from $100
method.fills: limit orders fill only when price trades 1 tick through (conservative); stops at their level or the gap open
method.selection: rank by in-sample Ndax net return among variants with >= 15 in-sample trades and <= 15% drawdown
method.robust_selection: Ndax-profitable in both halves of the selection period, profit factor >= 1.2, plus the trade and drawdown limits
